components.css: .ds-sheet-ground { padding: 24px 12px 48px; background: var(--color-base-200, #edf8ea); } .ds-sheet { max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 20px; border-radius: 28px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -28px rgb(27 33 27 / 0.35); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-count { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #3b443b); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 28px; } .ds-progress span { height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(96 129 95 / 0.18); } .ds-progress span.on { background: var(--color-primary, #60815f); } .ds-progress span.cur { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-ink, #1b211b); } .ds-question { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 2.5rem); font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--color-ink, #1b211b); text-wrap: balance; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a calm talk with one parent who has been through it, held in three fixed brand colours: a muted sage green, a pale leaf green and white. Nothing is loud. Pages are tall stacks of full-bleed bands that alternate white and light green, each holding one idea in a narrow reading column, with heavy, tightly tracked Inter headings doing the work that decoration would do elsewhere. The green itself appears as a solid field only where it asks for something: the hero panel, the quiz callout band, the primary pill button, the filled progress segments.

Depth is soft and low. Surfaces that are "held" (the quiz sheet, the hero panel, photos) sit on long, diffuse green-black shadows with a negative spread, so they lift without a hard edge. Everything else is flat and separated by tone, hairline green rules, or a light green fill. Shapes are generously rounded and buttons are always pills, which keeps the tool feeling gentle for visitors who arrive overwhelmed.

The system rejects the furniture of generic wellness and SaaS sites: no eyebrow or kicker labels over headings, no coloured left-border callouts, no glass or blur panels, no emoji, no unicode arrows standing in for icons.
keyCharacteristics: Three fixed brand colours plus a green-tinted ink ramp; no other hues.
Alternating white and light green full-bleed sections; a solid green band only for the quiz call to action.
Inter Variable at weight 750 with negative tracking for every heading; 17px body at 1.65 line height.
Long, soft, negative-spread shadows only on held surfaces.

rules.name: The Large-White-Only Rule
rules.body: White on sage green measures about 4.4:1, so white text on a green field is only ever large: headings, 19px bold body and 19px bold button labels. Never set small or regular-weight text on green; if copy on a green band needs to be longer, keep it 19px bold.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Green Link Rule
rules.body: Text links are Deep Ink with a sage green underline (1.5px, offset 5px, thickening to 2.5px on hover). Green is never the colour of running text or link text. There are no exceptions: even display-size labels such as the MAP and LIGHT framework acronyms are set in Deep Ink, and their step letters sit in green-outlined circles like the numbered step markers.

rules.name: The Fixed Brand Rule
rules.body: Sage green, Leaf Wash and white are binding brand colours. Do not add hues, gradients, or new tints beyond opacity steps of sage green.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter Variable is the only face. Hierarchy comes from weight (400 / 500 / 600 / 650 / 700 / 750), size and tracking, never a second family or a system display face.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no letter-spaced labels. Small labels are sentence case at 13px to 15px and sit inside or below content, never as a kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The Held-Surface Rule
rules.body: Only sheets, panels, menus and photos cast shadows. Cards, rows and buttons stay flat; state is shown with fill and ring, not elevation.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Anything you press is a pill. Rectangles are for content.

dos: Do alternate white and light green (#edf8ea) section bands, and end content pages on the green Quiz Callout.
Do set white text on green only at 19px bold or larger.
Do make text links Deep Ink with a 1.5px green underline at 5px offset that thickens to 2.5px on hover.
Do make every pressable control a pill, with a 2px green focus outline at 3px offset.
Do use Heroicons only: 24/outline in light green circles for value and benefit lists, 16/solid tinted green for UI.
Do mark external links with the External Arrow, kept on the last word's line.
Do keep reading columns at 680px to 720px and body text at 17px, 1.65 line height, Muted Ink.
Do use the gentle ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) at 160ms to 200ms for hover and state changes.
donts: Don't put small or regular-weight text on sage green, or set running text or links in green.
Don't introduce colours beyond the fixed green, light green, white and the ink ramp.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, or uppercase letter-spaced labels anywhere.
Don't use coloured border-left callouts; use a Leaf Wash note block instead.
Don't use glass, blur or translucent frosted panels.
Don't use emoji or unicode arrows as icons.
Don't give cards, rows or buttons drop shadows; shadows belong to sheets, panels, menus and photos.
Don't add a second typeface or system display face.
